## Hosted defect: verified tarball is not treated as a local publish input

Observed on `976e62b2e956a806ceb28d10ee14b31d38006193` (intended package version `2026.10.28`), not a local reproduction.

[Daily Release run 40672657971](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-jev/actions/runs/40672657971), [release job 122775665923](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-jev/actions/runs/40672657971/job/122775665923):
- 11:15:06 UTC: artifact handoff reports `release-artifact/package.tgz: OK`.
- The [publish command at this revision](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-jev/blob/976e62b2e956a806ceb28d10ee14b31d38006193/.github/workflows/release.yml#L767) is `npm publish release-artifact/package.tgz --access public --provenance --ignore-scripts`.
- 11:15:09, 11:15:40 and 11:16:12: npm exits128 after attempting `git --no-replace-objects ls-remote` on an SSH GitHub URL for `release-artifact/package.tgz.git`, followed by `Permission denied (publickey)`.
- 11:26:19: the workflow exhausts its three attempts plus10-minute registry reconciliation and reports the intended package coordinate unconfirmed.

## Expected / actual / impact
Expected: publish exactly the hash-verified local artifact, retaining provenance and existing approval/tree/identity safeguards. Actual: npm resolves the supplied argument as a GitHub repository rather than the verified local tarball. The release transaction fails after its metadata PR merged; a source merge is not evidence of npm publication.

The [accepted release-readiness record](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-jev/blob/976e62b2e956a806ceb28d10ee14b31d38006193/.agents/pm/chores/pm-jev-release-gate.toon) requires verified packed files and gated publishing. Its existing security/approval checks should remain intact.

## Acceptance / regression criteria
- Resolve the publication argument explicitly as an existing local artifact (for example an absolute or explicit `./` path), reverify its hash immediately before invoking npm, and fail locally if absent.
- Add a hermetic regression around the exact production publish argument and current npm-version behavior, covering present and missing tarballs; no GitHub shorthand/SSH lookup should occur.
- Preserve provenance, approval, immutable-tree verification and byte-identical reconciliation; do not fix this by adding SSH credentials or weakening controls.
- Verify the eventual official npm artifact separately from metadata merge and GitHub release creation, when the implementation owner authorizes a release.

## Scope and deduplication
Read-only hosted logs plus static workflow/canonical-record review. No publish, credentials, provider mutation or source execution performed. A local-path fix has not been tested here; the observed resolver behavior is proven, while the exact remediation remains implementation work. This is distinct from the already-reported runtime version-string issue on PR61. All-status repository issues/PRs and current PM records were checked; no owner of this publish-path failure was found.

> Root cause: npm parses the bare spec `release-artifact/package.tgz` as the GitHub shorthand owner/repo, hence the `git ls-remote ssh://git@github.com/release-artifact/package.tgz.git` calls. Fixed by publishing `./release-artifact/package.tgz` in #63, and in the same scaffold line in pm-evidence, pm-hypothesis, pm-lint, pm-memory, pm-review, pm-rlm and pm-swarm.
